How should I fix it? R6-F2, the five citations missing from the store, gets fixed either way, as the verdict asks.

options.label: Strengthen AC, move 14 (Recommended)
options.description: Amend AC-006 (TR-MCP-USECASE-018) and AC-008 (TR-MCP-USECASE-019) through the plugin to cover environment and platform reads reached through production code. The hostile gate must use invalid values (a plain file where a folder is expected) for every variable read along the way. Then move the 14 tests to Integration on both hosts with every temp variable set and restored, assertions unchanged. Extend the one-time search through production code (no scanner), run gate v5 with invalid values, fix R6-F2, rerun all gates at the new head, then HV round 7. Unit suite 4558 -> 4544; Linux lane 412 -> 426; Windows lane 388 -> 402. Test files only, no production change.

Same counts: unit 4558 -> 4544, Linux lane 412 -> 426, Windows lane 388 -> 402. No production change. The proof requirement stays implicit, which is how the gap got through this round.

options.label: Strengthen AC, add temp seam
options.description: Same AC amendment, but the 14 stay unit tests: temp-folder lookup and folder creation in three production classes go behind injected seams (mock gate before production, under BDPv4). Unit suite stays 4558. This adds a design mechanism, which the standing 'fix requirements, not mechanism' rule disfavors. It needs both an environment seam and a file-system/permissions seam to be platform-free, so it touches production code in three classes.

#Requires -Version 7.0
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Replaces the text of task 23 of TODO IMPL-UNITGREEN-001 through the plugin (workflow.todo.update): the task
    recorded the gates at 6a87791d; it now also records the second AC amendment ("Dependence + proof AC
    (Recommended)"), the helper fix 04841148 and the gates of record at c31f36d8. Tasks 1 to 22 are sent back
    unchanged and every task stays unchecked. Refuses unless the TODO has exactly 23 tasks, none checked, and task 23
    starts with the round 7 text. Reads back. Supports -WhatIf.
.PARAMETER GateSummary
    The gate results at the final head, appended to the task text.
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess)]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $GateSummary
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'CcPlugin.ps1')

Write-Output "Now: $((Get-Date).ToString('s'))"
$g = Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.todo.get' -Params ([ordered]@{ id = 'IMPL-UNITGREEN-001' })
$todo = Get-CcValue (Get-CcValue $g.Parsed 'payload') 'result'
$tasks = @(Get-CcValue $todo 'implementationTasks' | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })
if ($tasks.Count -ne 23) { throw "Expected 23 tasks, found $($tasks.Count)" }
if (@($tasks | Where-Object { [bool](Get-CcValue $_ 'done') }).Count -ne 0) { throw 'A task is checked; refusing.' }
if (-not ([string](Get-CcValue $tasks[22] 'task')).StartsWith('Round 7 fix of hostile validation round 6', [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { throw 'Task 23 is not the round 7 task; refusing.' }

$task23 = 'Round 7 fix of hostile validation round 6 (DISAGREE 97/95; R6-F1, R6-F2; operator 2026-10-26 "Strengthen AC, move 14 (Recommended)" and "Dependence + proof AC (Recommended)"; plan section 20). Requirements first through the plugin: TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006 and TR-MCP-USECASE-019 AC-008 (finally at 10:33:51 and 10:34:03): a test whose outcome can change with an environment variable it reads or writes, directly, through a test helper or through the production code it calls, is an integration test that sets and restores every variable it or the code it calls depends on, every name of a fallback chain included; a unit test may reach code that reads a variable only where the hostile gate shows its outcome does not change; the gate runs twice, folder variables at test-owned folders and then at test-owned regular files, with XDG_DATA_HOME following the scripted HOME. One-time search through production code (ug-r7-env-search.txt); hostile gate v5 (Start-HostileNukeRunWide5.ps1). Negative control ug-r7-hostile-v5-file-negative-2 at the round 6 code: 4544 passed, 14 failed, exactly the R6-F1 tests. BDPv4 test slices: mock gate ug-r7-clitemp-mockgate-1 4563/0/0 before the shared CliTempVariables helper; the 14 tests moved to Category=Integration inside it, assertions unchanged (commit 6a87791d); then mock gate ug-r7-chain-mockgate-1 4553/0/0 before the helper pointed the primary name at the test folder and every other name at a separate fallback folder, so primary-wins assertions discriminate again (commit 04841148, the last code head). R6-F2: the absent ids on the lines the branch adds are labeled historical (ug-r7-citations.txt). ' + $GateSummary + ' Awaiting hostile validation'
$updatedTasks = @(for ($i = 0; $i -lt 22; $i++) { [ordered]@{ task = [string](Get-CcValue $tasks[$i] 'task'); done = $false } }) + @(
    [ordered]@{ task = $task23; done = $false }
)
Write-Output ('BEFORE tasks={0} task23Length={1}' -f $tasks.Count, ([string](Get-CcValue $tasks[22] 'task')).Length)
Write-Output ('AFTER  tasks={0} task23Length={1}' -f $updatedTasks.Count, $task23.Length)
if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('IMPL-UNITGREEN-001', 'workflow.todo.update (replace task 23 text)')) {
    $u = Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.todo.update' -Params ([ordered]@{
            id                  = 'IMPL-UNITGREEN-001'
            implementationTasks = $updatedTasks
        })
    Write-Output "todo.update exit=$($u.ExitCode)"
    if ($u.ExitCode -ne 0 -or $u.Raw -match '(?im)^\s*type:\s*error') { Write-Output $u.Raw; exit 1 }
    $r = Get-CcValue (Get-CcValue (Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.todo.get' -Params ([ordered]@{ id = 'IMPL-UNITGREEN-001' })).Parsed 'payload') 'result'
    $after = @(Get-CcValue $r 'implementationTasks' | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })
    $unchanged = @(for ($i = 0; $i -lt 22; $i++) { [string](Get-CcValue $after[$i] 'task') -ceq [string](Get-CcValue $tasks[$i] 'task') }) -notcontains $false
    Write-Output ('READBACK tasks={0} tasksDone={1} done={2} tasks1to22Unchanged={3} task23={4}' -f $after.Count, @($after | Where-Object { [bool](Get-CcValue $_ 'done') }).Count, (Get-CcValue $r 'done'), $unchanged, ([string](Get-CcValue $after[22] 'task') -ceq $task23))
}

A test whose outcome can change with an environment variable is an integration test that sets and restores every variable it or the code it calls depends on, every name of a fallback chain included. Environment writers run one at a time. A unit test may reach code that reads a variable only where the hostile gate shows its outcome does not change; the gate runs twice, folder variables at folders and then at regular files, with XDG_DATA_HOME following the scripted HOME. Operator, 2026-10-21: "Strengthening Acceptance Criteria should always be the recommended option."
